BUILD_CODE: Trace the relevant entry point, interfaces and build command. Preserve callers and required formats. Make a coherent implementation, then exercise the real entry point and at least one boundary case. A successful compile alone does not establish correct behavior.
RUNTIME_CONFIG: Inspect the running process, effective configuration, paths, permissions and listening endpoints. Validate the required behavior through the real client or command after applying the change. Recheck persistence and working directory; do not confuse a configuration file with an effective running service.
MATH_NUMERICS: Translate each public mathematical requirement into a checkable invariant. Check domain restrictions, normalization, numerical stability and degenerate inputs. Test the actual callable interface with reproducible small examples; avoid substituting a plausible approximation for a specified algorithm.
DATA_INTEGRITY: Confirm input schema, encoding, ordering, missing values and requested output fields. Check counts and representative rows before and after transformation. Preserve the full dataset and exact output location. Do not silently drop difficult records or substitute a sample for the required output.
ARTIFACT_FORMAT: Inventory the required output files and their exact formats. Inspect real artifacts using the relevant parser or application. Validate dimensions, structure, contents and readability at the requested paths. A description, stub or screenshot cannot replace a requested executable or data artifact.
RESOURCE_STRATEGY: Determine the smallest faithful experiment that validates the method before expensive work. Reuse available packages and assets. Check runtime and storage early, use efficient algorithms, and reserve time to save and validate the complete requested result. Avoid repeated downloads or an unbounded search.
FINAL_VALIDATION: Write a short acceptance checklist from the public instruction, then inspect the environment and implement the smallest complete solution. Before finishing, run the actual requested entry point and check every deliverable, including edge cases, paths and output formats. Remove temporary diagnostic substitutions.
